evidence: docs/codex-runs/CURRENT_RUN.md says Current run: P30 while AGENTS.md and README point to GLOSS_P33_RELEASE_CANDIDATE_SM_TQ_SETTINGS_GUI_20260519; package.json desktop-smoke calls archived p33 script.
root_cause: Codex archive normalization moved P33 scripts but not all active references/receipts; multiple active truths remain.
fix_direction: Create a single CurrentRunTruthV1: choose next run GLOSS_P34_RUNTIME_TRUTH_INGESTION_REPAIR_20260524; update CURRENT_RUN.md, AGENTS.md, README validation block, package.json scripts, release receipt references; move P33 final receipt to historical/non-release unless replayed.

evidence: FINAL_RECEIPT.json under P33 has release_ready=true, but commands reference scripts/p33_release_preflight.py, p33_current_run_gate.py, p33_desktop_smoke_harness.py, and others that are missing from active scripts.
root_cause: Final receipt was not invalidated after stale-run script archival.
fix_direction: Set old receipt release_ready=false with supersession_reason or move to archive. New run must write FINAL_RECEIPT.json only after fresh-unzip replay and runtime smoke pass.

evidence: Runtime log shows dozens of ingestion failures for notebook 5c5c4f6e... not found, then a new notebook 256c66ca... is created and active state changes, while background ingestion continues against the missing notebook.
root_cause: Folder import captures a stale notebook_id and does not validate notebook existence before scheduling/walking/creating source records; background jobs lack notebook epoch/import batch identity.
fix_direction: Add ImportBatchV1 with notebook_id, notebook_epoch, import_batch_id. Validate notebook exists before spawn and at job start. Missing/superseded notebook cancels jobs as cancelled_superseded, not failed. Do not create source rows for missing notebooks.

evidence: Runtime log reports Background folder ingestion complete count=183 after many missing-notebook failures. UI shows 183 sources loaded although first import failed against missing notebook.
root_cause: Folder import counts attempted/created sources but not success/failure/cancelled terminal states.
fix_direction: Folder import receipt must include found, created, ingested_ready, failed, skipped_duplicate, skipped_unsupported, cancelled_superseded; UI must display partial/failure counts.
acceptance_gate: cargo test folder_import_receipt_counts_failures && npm test -- folderImport

evidence: Runtime log: semantic-memory manifest ingest failed: Ollama HTTP 400 input length exceeds context length on a source with 9262 words / 47 chunks.
root_cause: Adapter sends a whole source/chunk manifest through one semantic-memory ingest call without a local payload budget or retry splitting.
fix_direction: Add projection batching by chunk count + estimated tokens/chars. On Ollama context-length error, retry smaller batches and record per-chunk/source ProjectionFailureRecordV1. One large source must not fail whole notebook projection state.

evidence: Screenshot shows 12 context passages, 0 valid citations, 6 filtered. Log shows context assembled from 12 passages and provider response completed.
root_cause: Citation extraction depends on model-emitted numeric refs and filters unanchored/mismatched refs without detailed reasons; BM25 fallback does not have a release-grade CitationAnchorV1 path.
fix_direction: Introduce CitationAnchorV1 for every ContextPassage; model gets anchor list; backend validates citations by source_id, chunk_id, quote_digest; filtered citations carry reason codes and UI displays them.

evidence: Screenshot shows the answer/evidence panel dumping a massive comma-separated list of selected source UUIDs into the chat surface, hiding useful output/composer area.
root_cause: EvidenceDrawer joins selected/effective/excluded source ID arrays directly for normal display.
fix_direction: Replace normal display with compact source scope summary: all 183 sources, explicit 12 selected, excluded count. Put full IDs only behind collapsed diagnostics + copy JSON. Cap panel height.
acceptance_gate: npm test -- evidenceDrawer && npm run build

evidence: UI shows Backend requested semantic-memory-preview, Backend used gloss-local, Retrieval bm25-only, Memory semantic-memory-preview failed, Dense coverage 0/294. Log says native dense warmup skipped because native indexing disabled or scope empty.
root_cause: Requested backend, effective backend, feature availability, projection readiness, and fallback reason are spread across fields and can look contradictory.
fix_direction: Create RetrievalCapabilityDecisionV1 with requested_backend, effective_backend, decision_reason, build_feature_available, runtime_enabled, projection_ready, dense_ready, fallback_allowed, degraded. UI renders this one object.

evidence: chat/mod.rs sets source_scope_preserved to invalid_source_ids.is_empty(); gloss_local and semantic adapter provenance use source_scope_preserved=true even when fallback/degraded/filtering may occur.
root_cause: Preservation is treated as valid-ID check only; it ignores fallback type, missing chunks, semantic backpointer filtering, unanchored passages, and strict scope enforcement path.
fix_direction: Derive SourceScopeIntegrityV1: requested ids valid, effective ids match allowed set, no out-of-scope candidates, no unanchored context, fallback class allowed, projection links preserved. Only then preserved=true.

evidence: check:sm-tq-profile fails because scripts expect src-tauri/src/db/notebook_db.rs, src-tauri/src/commands/sources.rs, src-tauri/src/commands/chat.rs, src/components/settings/SettingsDialog.tsx, which were refactored to mod.rs/index.tsx paths.
root_cause: Validators hard-code pre-refactor paths instead of using a source path map.
fix_direction: Add scripts/gloss_source_path_map.py and update all validators to read current files; stale-path references become release blockers.

fix_direction: Create root SECURITY_AND_PRIVACY.md with exact local storage, API key, Ollama/cloud provider, Tauri capability, and data-flow limits. Update audit if canonical path changes.

surface: Source list refresh after folder import

evidence: UI shows 183 need summaries while log repeatedly says ingestion active, deferring summaries; after import it remains unclear whether summaries are queued, blocked, manual, or failed.

acceptance_gate: cargo test summary_queue_unblocks_after_batch_import summary_queue_not_blocked_by_projection_failure && npm test -- summaryState

evidence: Runtime uses gemma3:4b for chat while semantic-memory projection hits Ollama context length; UI/status does not make clear which embedding/projection model is used.

fix_direction: Settings/status show chat model, summary model, vision model, semantic embedding model, and projection endpoint separately. Projection refuses chat-only models unless configured as embedding-capable.
acceptance_gate: cargo test projection_rejects_chat_model_as_embedder && npm test -- settingsModelRoles

evidence: Log skips .lock and .zip, but app imports many code/docs files and treats unknown extension as text. Docs/spec list many document formats as intended, but current implementation excludes pdf/docx/xlsx/pptx and lacks extraction.

surface: Missing document ingestion formats from spec

evidence: Log: context_chars=22065, system_prompt_len=3830 for gemma3:4b; no visible evidence that prompt is clipped to model context before provider call.

fix_direction: Add PromptBudgetReceiptV1 with model context, system tokens estimate, history tokens estimate, source passage tokens, clipped passages, omitted reason. Gate prompt assembly before provider call.

surface: Large source projection failure contaminates notebook health

evidence: audit_retrieval_disclosures.py crashes with IndexError when no JSON payload path is provided.
